annotations.title: Wil consecrate themselues.
annotations.text: To such as of their owne accord, would bind them selues by vow ro certaine thinges not commanded, [1] God prescribeth a Rule containing three special obseruations; not to drincke wine, or aniething that may make drunck; not to cut their haire; and not to touch a dead corps. He appointeth likewise rites in making this profession, and calleth the professed Nazareites, that is, segregated or separated from the ordinarie state of people: though it was, for most part, but for a time, to be limited by the parties them selues, and in some perpetual, [2]as in Samson. Iudic. 13. Now what do Nazareites signifie, saith S. Gregorie (li. 33 c. 23. Moral.) but those that abstaine, and containe voluntarily from things osherwise lawful? [3] As from eating flesh, either for certaine daies and times, or altogether; from Mariage; from proprietie in worldlie goodes; and the like.

notes.text: God prescribed the rule of Nazareites, & the rites of their consecration.
The same was a figure of vowes both temporal and perpetual.
